name: Unagui Save Cart for WooCommerce
author: unagui

sections.description:
Don’t let your customers forget their favorites. Empower them to save, share, and return.
Unagui Save Cart for WooCommerce is a lightweight, high-performance plugin that allows logged-in customers to save their current shopping cart and restore it whenever they are ready to buy. Whether they are switching from mobile to desktop or waiting for payday, this tool ensures their shopping intent is never lost.

Why use Unagui Save Cart for WooCommerce?
Abandoned carts are often just “paused” decisions. By giving your users a dedicated space to manage their future purchases, you reduce friction and increase the chances of a completed sale.

🚀 Free Features: The Core Essentials

  • Unlimited Cart Saving: Logged-in users can name and save as many different carts as they need.
  • Centralized Management: A new “My Saved Carts” tab is automatically added to the WooCommerce My Account area.
  • One-Click Restoration: Customers can instantly restore any saved session into a fresh cart for a seamless checkout.
  • Fully Customizable: Easily change the title, placeholder text, and button labels from the settings to match your brand voice.

🔥 Unlock the full potential of Automated Sales Recovery

Upgrade now and transform a simple utility into a revenue-generating engine with automation and sharing tools. With Unagui Save Cart for WooCommerce Pro, you get access to the following features:

  • Automated Email Reminders: Schedule automatic emails to “nudge” customers who have saved carts but haven’t checked out yet.
  • Dynamic Coupon Generation: Automatically attach unique, time-sensitive discount codes to your recovery emails to incentivize immediate purchases.
  • Viral Cart Sharing: Allow customers to share their carts via WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook, X (Twitter), or a direct link. Perfect for gift-givers and B2B approvals.
  • Elementor Integration: A dedicated widget with full styling controls for pixel-perfect designs.
  • Admin Insights: View every saved cart in your dashboard to track popular products and customer intent before they even buy.

In addition, with the Pro version you will receive priority support from our dedicated team, ensuring any questions or issues are resolved quickly. Upgrade to Unagui Save Cart for WooCommerce Pro today to improve your store’s efficiency and maximize your profits. Visit our Unagui Save Cart for WooCommerce Pro page for more details and to purchase.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Unagui Plugins > Save Cart to configure the widget text.
  4. The “Save Cart” form will automatically appear on the Cart page (if enabled), or you can use the Gutenberg Block.
  5. Customers can find their saved carts under My Account > Saved Carts.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is an extension for WooCommerce and requires it to be installed and active.

Can guest users save carts?

No, users must be logged in so their carts can be safely stored and managed within their account profile.

Is it compatible with page builders?

The Free version works automatically or using Gutenberg Block, while the Pro version includes a native Elementor widget and shortcode.
